guidetextdraw_638958047._value:
Pilot Summer 2022 CSUF Voluntary 9/80 Work Schedule

The campus is piloting a voluntary summer 9/80 work schedule for CSUF full-time 12 month employees. This alternate work schedule is available as long as it is operationally feasible and does not disrupt normal business operations or services.

A regular workweek is considered to be Monday through Friday. For a 9/80 work schedule, employees work eight 9-hour days, one 8-hour day, and one day off in a 2-week period. This summer 9/80 work schedule provides for alternating Fridays off.

The summer 9/80 work schedule will be from May 30, 2022, through August 5, 2022 - (alternate Fridays off)

There will be two options for (9) hour shift start and end times:

7:30 am-5:00 pm with 30-minute lunch

8:00 am-5:30 pm with 30-minute lunch

Memorial Day, Monday, May 30, 2022, and Independence Day, Monday, July 4, 2022, will be (9) hour holidays.

Under the State pay plan, salaries are paid to employees for either 21 days (168 hours) or 22 days (176 hours), depending on the number of days in a pay period. This is based on a standard work schedule of Monday-Friday, 8 hours per day. If an employee works an alternate work schedule (i.e., 9/80), a fluctuation in hours occurs. If the hours worked exceed the 168 or 176 hours (of the respective pay period), FLSA rules and CSU policy requires payment to non-exempt employees for those excess hours. Excess hours cannot be accumulated or carried forward into subsequent pay periods. Deficit hours will be offset by any excess hours worked in following pay periods, as appropriate.

In compliance with CSU Technical Letter 2003-28 and the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), full-time non-exempt employees who participate in the summer work schedule will use excess hours to offset any deficit hour balances. If a deficit balance does not exist, employees will be compensated for any hours worked in excess of the standard hours in a pay period.

The manager will complete the Pilot Summer 9/80 Work Schedule Request Form in AEM and submit it to the employee for acknowledgment and submittal to Payroll Services. Forms should be submitted to Payroll Services on or before Friday, May 13, 2022.

If an employees cancels their participation in the 9/8- schedule prior to August 5th they must contact their manager and Payroll Services to determine next steps. Please be aware that due to payroll processing, employees may not be able to immediately go back to their normal working schedule.

If you have any questions regarding the summer 9/80 work schedule options, please contact Payroll Services at ext. 2521.

guidetextdraw_1867982522._value:
Summer 2026 CSUF Voluntary 9/80 Work Schedule

The campus is offering the voluntary summer 9/80 work schedule for CSUF full-time 12 month employees. This alternate work schedule is available as long as it is operationally feasible and does not disrupt normal business operations or services.

A regular workweek is considered to be Monday through Friday. For a 9/80 work schedule, employees work eight 9-hour days, one 8-hour day, and one day off in a 2-week period. This summer 9/80 work schedule provides for alternating Fridays off.

The manager will complete the Summer 9/80 Work Schedule Request Form in AEM and submit it to the employee for acknowledgment and submittal to Payroll Services. Fully executed forms must be submitted to Payroll Services through AEM on or before April 30, 2026. For new employees who begin work after May 01, 2026 – May 31, 2026, managers may reach out to Payroll Services at casgranillo@fullerton.edu. No AEM forms for new employees will be processed after May 31, 2026.

The summer 9/80 work schedule will be from May 24, 2026, through August 1, 2026 - (alternate Fridays off)

All employees must choose a beginning Friday for absence management updates.

Option 1 May 29 first Friday off.

Option 2 June 5 first Friday off.

Memorial Day, Monday, May 25, 2026 will be (9) hour holiday.

Under the State pay plan, salaries are paid to employees for either 21 days (168 hours) or 22 days (176 hours), depending on the number of days in a pay period. This is based on a standard work schedule of Monday-Friday, 8 hours per day.

Excess Hours

Non-exempt employees on alternate and/or compressed work schedules shall be paid for all hours worked in the pay period in excess of the standard state pay period. Employees will not be paid for excess hours worked in a pay period when an equal or greater deficit balance exists. Excess hours for a standard pay period will be calculated by the Absence Management system based on the employee work schedule. Hours in excess of the standard pay period are paid (all units except Unit 8) each pay period based on the employee’s work schedule (unless applied to deficit balance). Pay for the excess hours should issue from the State Controller’s Office approximately 15 days after the Absence Management calendar for the pay period has been closed

Deficit Hours
Non-exempt employees who have deficit hours in a given pay period may carry these deficit hours forward. Deficit hours for a standard pay period will be calculated by the Absence Management system based on the employee work schedule. These deficit hours shall be offset by excess numbers of hours (credits) worked in a subsequent pay period.

Annual Reconciliation of Deficit Hours
The campus is required to reconcile employee deficit hours at least once each calendar year in January. When reconciling an employee's deficit hours through December 31st, the affected employee may use available leave credits (Vacation, CTO, Holiday Credit, and/or Personal Holiday) to offset the deficit balance, or the campus must establish an accounts receivable, as appropriate, if no leave credits are available to offset the deficit.

If an employees cancels their participation in the 9/80 schedule prior to August 1st they must contact their manager and Payroll Services to determine next steps. Please be aware that due to payroll processing, employees may not be able to immediately go back to their normal working schedule.

If you have any questions regarding the summer 9/80 work schedule options, please contact Payroll Services at ext. 2521.
